description: SAR2UAV is a solo project focused on flood-impact mapping and priority-based UAV reconnaissance. It uses NASA-ISRO NISAR radar observations and OpenStreetMap road data to identify probable flood-affected areas in Houston, Texas, and rank 25 sectors for follow-up UAV reconnaissance. The prototype combines radar-derived flood severity with road exposure to support disaster-response planning. Developed independently by Swapnil Saha.
